node.title: Scalar dimension two forces an 81908-coordinate common core
node.closure: primitive-pencil root disjointness and reversible common-core shortening
node.statement: In the quotient scalar-family branch, either the scalar span has dimension three or four, or dimension two forces a common received-pair core J shared by all quotient types with |J|>=81908. For 38 represented projective directions, their chosen pair-core intersections are disjoint outside J and satisfy 38*134940-37|J|<=2097152. Subtracting the common pair and dividing both punctured received values and polynomial explanations by the locator of J reversibly shortens (n,K,m) to (n-|J|,K-|J|,m-|J|), preserving m-K=67472, all first-owned records, and residual quotient cores of size m-|J|-2.
